convertibility_reason: Uses iCustom indicator 'Instantaneous_TrendFilter' which is not a built-in MT5 indicator, and includes external .mqh library TradeAlgorithms.mqh for trade execution logic including position management and money management functions.

derived_values.name: TimeShiftSec - seconds per bar for signal timestamp alignment
min_rates_total - minimum bars required before strategy activates

other_exits: Opposite signal closes existing position: buy close when Osc1<Osc2 crossover, sell close when Osc1>Osc2 crossover, controlled by BuyPosClose/SellPosClose input booleans

position_sizing.conditional_logic: MMMode input selects between LOT (fixed lots) and deposit fraction modes; when MMMode=LOT, MM is treated as fixed lot size; when MMMode=FREEMARGIN, MM is a fraction of free margin for lot calculation

custom_logic_notes: Entry signals are evaluated on previous bars (SignalBar=1 default, comparing bar[1] vs bar[0] of indicator buffers). Crossover is detected by comparing Osc1[1]>Osc2[1] (prior bar relationship) with Osc1[0]<Osc2[0] (current relationship) for buy signals, meaning a fresh crossover from below. Signal timestamps (UpSignalTime/DnSignalTime) are calculated from SERIES_LASTBAR_DATE plus one bar duration for trade execution timing. BuyPosOpen/SellPosOpen/SellPosClose/BuyPosClose input booleans act as independent gates allowing selective enable/disable of each trade direction and close type. The CIsNewBar class controls bar-level execution; when SignalBar=0 the EA processes on every tick instead of new bar only.
python_conversion_notes: The Instantaneous_TrendFilter custom indicator must be reimplemented in Python - it uses two buffers where Buffer1 crosses Buffer0 for signals. The indicator's Alpha parameter (0.07) is an Ehlers instantaneous trendline smoothing coefficient. TradeAlgorithms.mqh provides BuyPositionOpen, SellPositionOpen, BuyPositionClose, SellPositionClose functions which handle order execution, position checking, and money management - these must be reimplemented. The CIsNewBar class for new-bar detection is straightforward to replicate. Note that SL/TP values (1000/2000) are in points not pips, so for 5-digit brokers these represent 100/200 pips respectively - no automatic digit adjustment is done in the code, the user must set appropriate point values. The SignalBar parameter allows backtesting on bar[1] (confirmed signals) or bar[0] (unconfirmed/repainting signals).
